title: Best AI Video Generators for Teachers in 2026: 7 Tools Compared
summary: Compare AI video tools for teachers in 2026. Golpo workflows for a document lesson, a checked solution, and a presenter or recording, plus plan and credit limits.
body_markdown:
Teach the concept, show the working, and keep your own presence when it helps. **Golpo** is built to be the complete workflow for that lesson. You can start from tomorrow's worksheet, from a script you already checked against the answer key, or from a short recording of yourself. Golpo drafts narration in Prompt Mode when you want a draft, or speaks the words you supply in Script Mode, plans the scenes, and outputs a video your students can rewatch. You review it before it goes out.


This page is for K-12 teachers, tutors, coaching centers, and instructors who need lesson videos and worked examples without a video editor on staff. Golpo publishes it and is one of the tools compared. The other products are Synthesia, HeyGen, Loom, Canva for Education, Pictory, and InVideo. Competitor details below restate earlier public descriptions and should be re-checked on the linked pages. Nothing here is a placement fee.


→[Try tomorrow's problem in Golpo](https://video.golpoai.com/) ·[Check plan limits](https://video.golpoai.com/pricing)


**Verification note.** Golpo plan, presenter, and credit facts were aligned to current product guides on October 12, 2026. Competitor claims still need a fresh read of[Canva for Education](https://static-cse.canva.com/blob/48/Canva-for-Education.pdf) ,[Loom](https://www.loom.com/pricing) ,[Synthesia](https://www.synthesia.io/pricing) ,[HeyGen](https://www.heygen.com/pricing) ,[Pictory](https://pictory.ai/pricing) , and[InVideo](https://invideo.io/pricing/) .


## Three ways to start the same lesson in Golpo


These are three production routes for one class, not three different products. A full side-by-side of the same worksheet (worked solution, teacher-presented recap, and a reviewed language variant) is the recipe at the end of this guide. It is not a set of files already embedded here.


- **Document to lesson.**[Prompt Mode](https://video.golpoai.com/guide/golpo-prompt-vs-script-mode-guide) drafts narration from a worksheet, chapter, or topic. Edit script before creating video, then render. An upload does not check the pedagogy or the answer. All plans can generate; length and controls vary.
- **Checked solution in Script Mode.** Paste the working you already verified, or the official key's reasoning in your own words after you have confirmed it. Script Mode renders that narration. Budget about 1,050 characters per selected minute. Put drawing directions in Video Instructions, not in the spoken lines. In the API,` custom_script` is the narration;` enable_script_only_mode` only generates a script.
- **You, beside the explanation.**[AI Presenter](https://video.golpoai.com/guide/golpo-ai-presenter) uses a stock presenter or an authorized selfie. Layouts include side-by-side, circle, full-screen, and Auto, which gives a busy derivation more room. That presenter is synthetic, not a recording of you.[Picture-in-Picture](https://video.golpoai.com/guide/golpo-picture-in-picture-guide) keeps a real webcam or uploaded video visible. Audio-only does not create a face, and a language setting does not translate that soundtrack. See[Own Narration](https://video.golpoai.com/guide/golpo-ai-own-narration-guide) .

## Controls that keep a lesson teachable


- **On-screen text from the script only.** On Canvas and Sketch, this limits generated labels to the script source. Golpo may show a subset, not every word. It is not a caption track and not a check that the math is right. In the API, set` onscreen_text_from_script_only` . See[on-screen text](https://video.golpoai.com/guide/golpo-onscreen-text-from-script-only) .
- **Canvas Expanded for a derivation.** Expanded spreads steps across scenes so a transformation has room. Compact groups a whole process. Notebook is Compact-only. Color starts at Growth. In the API, an unsuffixed style value selects Compact, and` _legacy` selects Expanded on the ten pre-Notebook styles. See[Compact vs Expanded](https://video.golpoai.com/guide/golpo-canvas-compact-vs-expanded-styles) .
- **Custom Scenes for one reasoning step at a time.** Move sentence boundaries so a justification stays with the line it explains, within the engine limit. The map does not rewrite the solution or prove it. Growth and higher, and Pay As You Go. See[Custom Scenes](https://video.golpoai.com/guide/golpo-custom-scenes-sentence-selection) .
- **Real software footage.** Own Media inserts an authorized screen recording or screenshot into the explainer. A picture Golpo draws of a button is not proof of the software. Business and higher, and Pay As You Go. A live screen-and-camera session is a different job; Loom is a recorder for that session. Confirm Loom's current AI features on its pricing page before you compare them to generation.
- **A language your students actually use.** Each language is a separate render. Creator and higher include multilingual features; Starter can add them. 45+ languages are listed. Confirm the current batch size in the product. Someone who knows the language checks terms. See pricing for variant credits.
- **Voice Instructions** steer pace and pronunciation of a generated voice, including how to say a symbol aloud. Creator and higher, and Pay As You Go. They do not clone a teacher and they do not change an Own Narration recording. See[Voice Instructions](https://video.golpoai.com/guide/golpo-voice-instructions-power) .
- **Frame editing** can fix a wrong label or a cluttered frame. It does not repair the spoken line. The first edited version is free across sessions until finalized. All paid plans; later versions charged on the selected duration of that version. If the narration is wrong, edit the script and render again. See[video editing](https://video.golpoai.com/guide/golpo-video-editing-guide) .


## How the other six tools fit a classroom job


Use this as a map of jobs, then confirm current behavior in each vendor's docs. Golpo can cover presenter-led and footage-based lessons; those jobs are not reserved for another product.


- **Synthesia.** Public materials describe AI avatars delivering a script, including a large language list with lip-sync. Confirm the current count and whether a given plan draws a step-by-step derivation. A same-lesson sample is the fair test. Pricing is per the vendor's current page.
- **HeyGen.** Public materials emphasize photorealistic avatars and multilingual lip-sync. Confirm languages and dubbing scope on HeyGen's current pages. That dubbing feature is not the same thing as Golpo's separate language render or Golpo's presenter beside a derivation.
- **Loom.** You record the screen and camera; Loom has described AI summaries and chapters. It fits a live software walkthrough or spoken feedback on a student's file. It does not replace a generated lesson, and Golpo Own Media does not replace a recording you still need to make live. Confirm free-tier limits on Loom's pricing page.
- **Canva for Education.** Design-led slides and simple animation when you build each scene. Canva has published free access for verified K-12 teachers and students. Confirm eligibility in the education overview. Canva does not, in that description, draft and narrate a worked solution from a worksheet.
- **Pictory.** Repurposing long recordings or articles into shorter clips. Confirm current inputs on Pictory's site. It is a different job from creating the first explanation of a problem.
- **InVideo.** Script-led video that public materials tie to stock footage and text. Useful for a course intro or a class announcement when stock images are enough. Confirm current generation behavior before you use it for a specific diagram.


## Plan, selected duration, and credits


A credit is a selected minute of standard video, not a promise that one subscription renders any length. **1 credit equals 1 selected minute** for a standard lesson. Prices are on[Golpo pricing](https://video.golpoai.com/pricing) . This guide does not quote dollar amounts.


- **Monthly pool and per-video cap are different.** A plan with 60 credits can cover many short videos. It does not raise the maximum length of a single render. Current published tables list Creator at about 15 seconds to 2 minutes per video. A four-minute lesson is a Growth duration on those tables, which list lengths up to about 4 minutes, plus color. Confirm the live table before you assign homework around a long video.
- **Starter** is the entry paid plan for shorter black-and-white videos. Multilingual access on Starter is an add-on. Creator includes multilingual features and Voice Instructions, still inside its per-video cap.
- **AI Presenter** requires Creator or higher, or Pay As You Go,
- **Custom Scenes and color** start at Growth (Custom Scenes are also on Pay As You Go). **Own Narration, Picture-in-Picture and Own Media** are Business and higher, and Pay As You Go. Frame editing: all paid plans.
- On Pay As You Go, edit-script-before-video is charged 10% after the script and 90% after the video.
- The Free plan includes one 1-minute watermarked preview. Download it without a watermark for $9.99, or subscribe to download it at no extra charge. A class library needs a paid option with the required generation allowance.


For a hypothetical two-minute lesson from one worksheet, a standard Script Mode solution is 2 credits and one additional language variant of the standard lesson is another 2 credits. Frame-editing a later two-minute version bills that selected duration again. None of those three files is embedded on this page.


## Recipe: tomorrow's misunderstood problem


Run this on the problem students missed most recently. The steps are a recipe. The exam videos higher up are separate examples.


1. **Source.** The problem statement and the answer key, or your own fully worked solution that you have already checked. Remove other students' names if the file came from submitted work.
2. **Settings for the worked solution.** Script Mode with the checked narration. Canvas Expanded. Custom Scenes so each algebraic or scientific move has its own scene, on a plan that includes them. On-screen text from the script only. Voice Instructions for how to say symbols. Selected duration long enough for the script and inside the plan cap. If the explanation needs more than the Creator per-video cap, use Growth or the current plan that lists that length.
3. **Script review.** Read the script against the key: signs, units, conditions, and the last line. Prompt Mode is available when you want Golpo to draft a concept overview, and that draft gets the same check.
4. **Result.** Render the worked solution. Students should be able to restate the method, which you can only know by asking them. The video's existence is not that measurement.
5. **One correction.** If a label shows the wrong sign and the voiceover is right, frame-edit the label on all paid plans. If the spoken line is wrong, fix the script and render again. Frame editing does not change audio.
6. **One reuse, same worksheet.** Either a teacher-presented recap (stock or photo AI Presenter, or real Picture-in-Picture if you need your actual face and voice) or a second language variant that a qualified reviewer checks. Say which system did which job when you share the files. A presenter recap is not an interactive quiz, and a language variant is not a translation of a finished Own Narration file.


## Review checklist


- Answer key checked before students see the video. Include notation, units, and the final result.
- No other student's work or personal data in the upload.
- Rights for a selfie presenter, a voice, and any software clip. Describe a photo presenter as synthetic.
- Captions and a transcript live with the player you publish to. On-screen labels are not captions.
- Each language variant reviewed by someone who knows that language.
- LMS, quiz scores, and watch analytics are outside Golpo.
- Write down plan, selected minutes, presenter type, and credits for the solution, the correction, and the recap or language variant.


## FAQ


### Which AI video tool is best for K-12 teachers?


For a lesson or worked example students rewatch, start in Golpo from the worksheet or a checked script, and add a presenter or your own recording when your presence helps. Canva for Education remains a strong fit for decks you design yourself; confirm current educator eligibility. Other presenter products are worth a same-lesson sample, not a required detour.


### Which AI video tool is best for tutors and coaching centers?


Golpo fits a tutor who already knows the method: attach the answer key, review or paste the solution, and render a video students can replay. An upload is not a checked solution library. The embedded exam examples on this page still need a key check before you assign them.


### Which AI video tool is free for teachers?


Golpo's Free plan includes one 1-minute watermarked preview. Download it without a watermark for $9.99, or subscribe to download it at no extra charge. Canva has published free education access for verified teachers and students; confirm current eligibility. Confirm other vendors' free limits on their pricing pages.


### Can the AI handle real exam questions like SAT, JEE, or NEET?


Golpo can illustrate a question you provide, and the videos embedded here are published examples of that. Correctness still requires you to check steps, signs, units, and the final result against the answer key. Put the checked working in Script Mode when the wording must stay exact. An unreviewed upload is not a solution set.


### Can I make the same lesson in multiple languages?


Golpo renders a separate variant per language. Creator and higher include multilingual features; Starter has a language add-on. 45+ languages are listed. A teacher or colleague who knows the language reviews each variant. Changing the language does not translate an Own Narration recording. Confirm current language lists and lip-sync claims for other tools on their own pages.


### What if I want my own voice in the videos?


Own Narration on Business and higher, and on Pay As You Go, uses your audio to drive new visuals. Picture-in-Picture keeps you visible. Audio-only does not create a face. AI Presenter from a photo is a synthetic presenter, not that recording. Voice Instructions steer a generated voice and do not clone you.


### Does a Creator plan include a four-minute lesson?


No. Monthly credits are a pool of selected minutes, not the maximum length of one video. Current published plan tables cap Creator at about two minutes per video. Growth is the tier that lists longer durations, including about four minutes. Confirm the live caps on the pricing page before you script a long lesson.


### Can Golpo show the teacher beside the explanation?


Yes. AI Presenter places a stock presenter or an authorized photo beside the lesson. Layouts include side-by-side, circle, full-screen, and Auto. Creator and higher, and Pay As You Go. Picture-in-Picture is the path when the face must be your real recording.


## Start with tomorrow's problem and the answer key


Take the problem your current class misunderstands most often. Bring the answer key. In[Golpo](https://video.golpoai.com/) , render the checked working, then one reuse of that same problem: a presenter or picture-in-picture recap, or a language variant you can review. Afterward, ask a few students to explain the method back, and note how long you spent reviewing the script and frames. That is the pilot. It is not a promise about grades. If the lesson must run longer than your plan allows in one file, split it or move to the plan whose per-video cap covers it. Limits and credit rates are on[pricing](https://video.golpoai.com/pricing) .
